evidence: grep of app/engines/validation.py for vendor_hint
recommendation: Implement vendor_hint or delete it so the contract does not promise vendor-specific validation.

requirement: binary-detection cannot be evaded by diluting control characters
input: 980-char payload with 9% C0 control characters (below the 0.1 threshold)
actual: is_valid=True issues=[] — control characters are passed downstream untouched
evidence: validation.py:209-211 uses a single global ratio with no per-line or per-run check; 9% of control bytes is accepted
recommendation: Reject any C0 control character other than \t/\r/\n outright rather than averaging them.
